resources.string: Verification stopped (%1$s). Tap VERIFY to try again.
COMPLETE: the recording was closed and every one of its objects verified.
INCOMPLETE: the recording was closed, but some of its objects are missing on the relay.
ALTERED: objects that are not yours were found on the relay. They are excluded.
INTERRUPTED: the recording was never closed. Its objects are verified one by one; its end is not certified.
Recorded before the update: an object is verified only if it carries a valid signature.
Recorded before the update, frozen on the relay: an object is verified only if it carries a valid signature.
Anomaly: the closure recorded on the relay is not valid.
Timestamp: the proof matches these recordings. The Bitcoin anchoring is checked with the desktop tool.
Timestamp: the proof does NOT match the verified recordings.
No verified video in this report.
No video among the objects kept apart.

These objects were stored before the relay kept signatures. Nothing proves they are yours or unchanged: an object sealed to your identity can come from anyone who knows its public key. They are kept apart from the verified testimony and never counted in it. You can watch them here and export them, to a separate folder marked \"not-verified\". Only recordings are exported from here: a timestamp proof among them is left to the desktop tool (frappuccino-cli fetch-archive), which keeps every such object apart.
Export objects that are NOT verified?

Nothing proves these recordings are yours or unchanged: they were stored before the relay kept signatures. They go to a separate folder, marked \"not-verified\" like each file in it, never together with the verified testimony. Like any export, the copy leaves the app: it is decrypted, the emergency wipe cannot erase it, and any app with access to the chosen folder can read it.
Exported to a separate folder marked \"not-verified\".

The exported copy leaves the app: it is decrypted, the emergency wipe cannot erase it, and any app with access to the chosen folder can read it. Only verified recordings are exported, with the timestamp proof and its salt when the proof matches.
No file picker on this phone: export is not possible.
The export did not start. Start it again from the report.
